acceptance.accepted_history_rule: Only the event exactly anchored by CURRENT.latest_event commit+path+digest is accepted history.
acceptance.duplicate_rule: Existing deterministic claim path is DUPLICATE; do not replace claim, outbox, event, or CURRENT.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Second CURRENT fetch must remain exact v67/blob b50282fbf38e8f6c3d7cbeb324961aac3d2413cd/projection digest 5352ab8d7b0cb32288da7d52975bc8e68bfba147e082277cd4b8373fb00273b3 before one blob-SHA-guarded replacement; final readback must be v68.
acceptance.slack_gate: Slack post is prohibited before version advance. After exact v68 readback, post once with the deterministic delivery marker, intentionally leave the Git receipt absent, then perform one bounded channel read. Exactly one exact-marker match reconstructs the receipt and suppresses repost; zero matches may post; multiple matches require conflict and HOLD.

campaign_decision.rationale: C17 established durable outbox creation, receipt-present replay suppression, exact accepted-head filtering, and exact-marker reconciliation for the post-before-receipt ambiguity window. The remaining guarantee is at-least-once/best-effort because Slack visibility and Git receipts are separate.
campaign_decision.revision: Add a deterministic Slack delivery marker and bounded reconciliation before any recovery repost. Exactly one exact-marker message reconstructs a receipt without repost; zero matches permits one post only after the exact accepted-head gate; multiple matches append conflict evidence and HOLD. Preserve receipt-present and exact-head filters.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This wake intentionally simulates a missing Git receipt in the same process after Slack accepts the message, then uses one bounded channel read to find an exact deterministic marker and reconstruct the receipt without reposting. It is not an actual crash, restart, delayed Slack index, concurrent recovery-worker, force-push, alternate-branch, channel-migration, edit, or deletion test. A bounded read can miss an older or temporarily invisible message; multiple exact markers remain ambiguous. Claim, outbox, event, CURRENT, Slack, channel read, receipt, and observation are separate effects. Git provides no cross-file transaction, database isolation or uniqueness, linearizability, exactly-once execution, cross-branch exclusion, or Slack atomicity.

probe.name: SLACK_MARKER_RECONCILIATION_AFTER_MISSING_GIT_RECEIPT_V4
probe.result: After exact v68 readback, create one Slack message containing the deterministic delivery marker, omit the Git receipt, read a bounded recent channel window, and require exactly one exact-marker match before reconstructing the receipt without a second Slack post.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the claim, outbox, event, Slack message, reconstructed receipt, or reconciliation observation. If v68 is later invalid, append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version. If Slack delivery is wrong, duplicated, missing, or ambiguous, append a correction or conflict receipt without rewriting prior evidence.
